comment: OPT-IN drop-in replacement for css:config/storage/key-value/resource-store.json that encrypts internal values at rest with AES-256-GCM.
To enable, replace the import of resource-store.json with this file and set the CSS_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable to a secret passphrase.
Enabling this on an existing deployment is safe: previously written plaintext values are still readable and are re-encrypted on their next write.
WARNING: losing the CSS_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY value makes all encrypted secrets (including the OIDC signing key) permanently unrecoverable.
Locks are stored through BackendKeyValueStorage and are intentionally left unencrypted.
A storage that writes directly to a low-level store. This is necessary to prevent infinite loops with stores that also use storage.
Currently only used for storing locks, where keys are always hashed, which is why this is not wrapped by a MaxKeyLengthStorage for now.

@graph.comment: Internal value storage, transparently encrypting values at rest with the key from CSS_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
Block external access to the storage containers to avoid exposing internal data.
Marks the /.internal/ storage container as an auxiliary resource, thereby hiding it from container representations.
